description: This is a unit test class for the GlobalCommandRegistry, testing its immutability, command recognition, parsing capabilities, and exception handling.

classes.name: GlobalCommandRegistryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the GlobalCommandRegistry, verifying its behavior and exception handling.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by obtaining an instance of GlobalCommandRegistry and an empty DittoHeaders object.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the GlobalCommandRegistry class is immutable.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryKnowsJsonTypeTestCommand
methods.description: Verifies that the registry recognizes the TestCommand type.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryParsesTestJsonObject
methods.description: Tests parsing a valid JSON object into a TestCommand instance.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryWrapsExceptionInDittoJsonException
methods.description: Ensures that parsing an invalid JSON object throws a DittoJsonException.

methods.name: globalCommandRegistryThrowsJsonTypeNotParsableException
methods.description: Checks that unrecognized command types throw a JsonTypeNotParsableException.
